Name: SH's Wild Animals
Author: Plurffle
TagLine: SH's Wild Animals is a mod for ConcernedApe's Stardew Valley. This mod adds over 40+ animals in different locations of the game, including several other locations from SVE and RSV if you have them installed.
Description:
Here is a mod that I was thinking about last year, but I had no idea how to implement it until today. I love Stardew Valley's critters, but I was a little sad by how I don't see them often (aside from butterflies and the occasional birds) and how they usually run off to hide in a bush/tree (it is rather realistic though). So, here comes my Wild Animals mod to fill that animal-shaped void in my heart!

This mod adds numerous animals to multiple places in-game, depending on the time, weather, and season. You are pretty much guaranteed to see the animals as long as you have access to the areas that they spawn in. They tend to wander so you may or may not lose sight of some of them, especially if they wander behind the trees or in the grass. Quick note: my SVE and RSV additions are based on personal preference, so I'm really sorry if they do not match what those mods' locations are based on.

These animals don't really do much of anything and are more of just moving decor for your valley that occasionally makes noises. I do hope I'll be able to add some sort of gameplay mechanic or more interactivity with these animals someday, but that idea may take a while (if it even ever gets implemented due to my inexperience with modding).

Most animals are randomized by default: animals that are considered as "solitary" in behavior in the wild are not guaranteed to show up in groups while the "social" animals are always in groups, a small portion of them also have a chance of not showing up at all. This is to make sure that the mod feels a little more varied. Some animals also have coat variants, so they do not look the same every day (this includes the squirrels, rabbits, foxes, and a few others).

FAQs
[spoiler]
Q: Is this mod compatible with other mods?
A: This mod should work with other mods. The only issue is that some animals have a higher chance of getting stuck in trees/bushes added from other mods. This mod should be compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded's map changes.

Q: Is this mod compatible with multiplayer or the mobile version of the game?
A: I have not gotten the chance to personally test this with multiplayer and on mobile, unfortunately. However, the Custom Companions modding framework is compatible with multiplayer, so that means my mod should be multiplayer-compatible.

Q: Why are there mod-exclusive animals? Can they be available in the version without those mods soon?
A: There are mod-exclusive animals because certain mods add new locations to the game and I am not sure about where to place them in vanilla maps yet. If you do not have any of the other mods, then my mod will automatically adjust itself. There are currently no mod-exclusive animals in version 1.1.3.

Q: There are too many animals! Can I lessen the number of animals per map?
A: Most animals are randomized by default (mainly the ones that are considered solitary). There is a config file that gets generated when you first launch the game with the mod. There are two options you can choose that will affect the animals; True or False.

Q: I want to use retextures for the animals. Can I use pre-existing retextures that were made before this mod existed? Can I make my own retextures?
A: Yep! :D All of my animals use vanilla Stardew Valley animals as a base, so all that really matters is the sprite size. (i.e. My foxes use the dog sprites as a base, so you can use any dog/cat retextures to replace them). There are a select few that do not use any of SV's sprite base/size, which use 24 x 24 pixel size. Btw, you can even upload any retextures of my animals if you want! :)

Q: Can I use the files from this mod for other mods to upload?
A: Yep! :D I don't really mind if you reupload my animals for different mods!... Although, I am not entirely sure about how I feel if they were hidden behind a paywall. So, uhh, I'd prefer that these are to remain free. Donations are fine though! I just don't want my assets to be part of something that needs to be purchased. :(

Q: Can I use older versions of this mod?
A: If you prefer to use older versions of this mod, you definitely can. They should still work in your game regardless of how old they are, just be sure to use only one copy of this mod at a time. Just a small warning: some older versions may contain unfixed bugs.

Q: There are barely any animals during winter. Is something wrong?
A: A lot of the animals are not available during the winter to simulate what real-life animals do when it's extremely cold out. There are a few animals that persist and show up during the winter though.
[/spoiler]

Known Issues
[spoiler]
Animals that are swimming may look like they're swimming above water when they're too close to land. This is only a visual issue and will not happen too often anyway.
[/spoiler]

If you want to know when and where exactly do the animals appear in, you can check this mod's alternate download page in NexusMods for their schedules.
